data.title: 伽玛 · 雾镜上写的名字
data.description: 会长私汤的水汽漫过镜面。伽玛赤裸着站在镜前，湿漉漉的靛蓝长发贴在背上，一只手在雾面上慢慢写下“暗影”两个字，另一只手探进水汽弥漫的腿间。镜中精灵的耳尖红得滴血——这世上最赚钱的女人，最见不得人的账目，从不记在纸上。
data.location: 会长套房私人浴室·深夜
data.action: 赤裸站在雾气镜面前，一手在镜面写字，一手探入腿间
data.camera: medium shot, front view toward fogged mirror
data.promptProse: In her private bath, adult Gamma stands naked before the fogged mirror, one finger writing a name in the steam, the other between her legs, ears burning red in the warm mist.
data.animaCaption: The richest woman in the kingdom keeps one ledger off the books — written in steam, erased by morning.
